avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 induction reduces diazepam levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; notify prescriber if currently taking

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; increased sedation and cognitive impairment
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue kava kava before diazepam therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression effects; enhanced sedation and impaired psychomotor function
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; space dosing by at least 8 hours if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; use lowest effective doses

caution_supplements.name: Chamomile
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive sedation; minor interaction risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; inform patient of cumulative CNS effects

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase diazepam levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of overdose; limit grapefruit consumption

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases diazepam bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet during diazepam therapy

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; enhanced sedation and respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid alcohol; educate patient on severe interaction risks

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slow absorption but increase overall bioavailability variably
caution_foods.action: Take diazepam consistently with or without food for predictable effect

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and cognitive impairment, particularly during initiation or dose escalation. Counsel patients to avoid all CNS depressants and maintain consistent dietary habits to prevent fluctuations in drug levels and clinical response.
